data.title: V1TER Residence
data.about:
Discover unparalleled sophistication at V1ter Residence JVC, a landmark of luxury in the heart of Dubai's Jumeriah Village Circle, nestled in district 12. This serene haven is ideally situated away from the hustle and bustle, yet remarkably close to the city's major attractions, offering the best of both worlds. 

V1ter Residence, a majestic 25-story tower, presents an array of stunning studio to 3 bedroom apartments, each furnished with exquisite Italian furniture and appliances. V1ter Residence boasts an array of amenities, including a vast public space, a three-level parking garage, a refreshing swimming pool, and a relaxing sauna. 

Embrace a lifestyle of luxury and convenience at V1ter Residence Dubai, where every apartment promises breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline. With an expected handover in Q3 2025, V1ter Residence in JVC is poised to transform the concept of modern living in Dubai. Experience the pinnacle of comfort and elegance with a home that exceeds all expectations, mere minutes from everything you need.

location_tile.title: In the Middle of It All at V1ter Residence JVC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated in the lively core of New Dubai, V1ter Residence shines as a beacon of modernity in JVC, a neighborhood known for its rapid growth and vibrant atmosphere. V1ter Residence prides itself on its strategic location, providing seamless access to an array of facilities including elite daycare, educational institutions, expansive parks (with more than 30 green areas), comprehensive supermarkets, gourmet restaurants, cutting-edge fitness centers, and refreshing swimming pools, all just a short walk away.

Perfectly located, V1ter Residence allows for easy travel to major roads like Mohammed Bin Rashid Road, Barsha Road, and Al Khail Road, facilitating quick commutes to essential business hubs such as Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, and JLT, minus the traffic woes. V1ter Residence, presented by Object1, embodies Dubai's modern lifestyle—a peaceful community ambiance with unmatched access to the city’s business and entertainment spots. Experience the ultimate combination of convenience and peace at V1ter Residence, reimagining life in Dubai's JVC.
